chunks: And from him, from Muhammad ibn Abdillah ibn Ja'far, from his father, from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Hamid, from Saif ibn 'Amirah, from Mansur ibn Hazim, who said:

I heard him (peace be upon him) say: 'Whoever a year passes without visiting the grave of al-Husayn (peace be upon him), Allah will shorten his lifespan by a year. And if I said that one of you dies before his appointed term by thirty years, I would be truthful, and that is because you leave visiting him. So do not leave it, for Allah will prolong your lifespans and increase your provisions. And if you leave visiting him, Allah will diminish your lifespans and provisions. So compete in visiting him and do not neglect it, for al-Husayn ibn Ali (peace be upon him) is a witness for you before Allah the Exalted, and before His Messenger, and before Ali, and before Fatimah, may the prayers of Allah be upon them all.'
ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual benefit of visiting the grave of Imam al-Husayn?
ai.summary: This narration from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* highlights the tangible spiritual economy of Ziyarat, linking physical presence at the grave to divine prolongation of life (*madd al-'umr*) and abundance of provision (*rizq*). It underscores the unique Shia belief in the active intercessory role of Imam al-Husayn, who serves as a witness for his visitors before Allah, the Prophet, and the Ahl al-Bayt, thereby reinforcing the theological significance of the grave as a locus of divine mercy and validation.
